name: Loot trial objectives gate on their level, not on the item id (Amphibian Angler 609)
contract: LOOT_ITEM_BEFORE_LEVEL objectives are 'count/item/level' (609: 1/6294/15, 1/6310/20, 1/13882/40, 1/13901/60), while kill and quest objectives are 'target/level'.
The lifecycle read the second value as the gate for every type, so loot trials gated on the item id (6294) and the XP cap and level-up checks never applied to their real gates.
Expected: the level-gate e2e sees four gates starting at level 15, caps XP at level 14, survives a forced level at the gate, and completes after every item is looted.

steps.label: Run the level-gate e2e for Amphibian Angler
DISCRIMINATING: four gates, the first at level 15
XP stops one level short of the first gate
A forced level at the gate does not kill
The full run completes the trial
